data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for the AppsFlyer mobile attribution and analytics SDK.
data.what_it_does: Integrates the AppsFlyer mobile attribution and analytics SDK into Flutter apps on Android and iOS. It allows tracking in-app events, ad revenue, deep linking, and campaign measurement. It handles SDK initialization, session management, and purchases via an RPC layer.
use_when: You need mobile attribution and app installation tracking
You want to measure campaign performance and ad revenue
You need deep linking support via AppsFlyer
avoid_when: Your app targets outdated Flutter versions below 3.35.0
You use alternative attribution SDKs and do not want to bundle AppsFlyer
strengths: Official plugin supported directly by AppsFlyer
Bundles latest Android and iOS AppsFlyer SDKs and purchase connectors
Comprehensive documentation and guides for migration and setup
weaknesses: Strict version pinning on Android toolchain and Kotlin/Gradle plugins
Major breaking changes in v7 requiring significant migration effort
data.setup_notes: Requires minimum Flutter 3.35.0, Dart 3.9.0, Android API 21, and iOS 13.0. Requires configuring developer keys, app IDs, deep link listeners, and matching strict Android Gradle and Kotlin plugin versions.
